name: OrgSwitcherPanel
description: The switcher's list, always open, for a sheet, a page or the gallery.
signature: <O extends SwitcherOrganisation>({ organisations, remote, value, onValueChange, recent, labels: labelsProp, searchPlaceholder, }: OrgSwitcherPanelProps<O>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: labels
props.description: Display and accessibility labels supplied by the application.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: organisations
props.description: Complete local hierarchy, or the loaded flat server results when remote is supplied.

props.name: recent
props.description: Previously selected IDs, ordered most recent first.

props.name: remote
props.description: Controlled server search and paging; parent links and local recents are ignored.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Prompt in the searchable hierarchy. Defaults to "Find an organisation".

props.name: value
props.description: Selected organisation ID, or null for the all-organisations scope.
